property_summary: For any caller and any calldata, when Owner calls Command forwarding nonzero ETH, the reference contract forwards that ETH to the target (call succeeds or fails but accepts value); the mutant forbids any nonzero msg.value and thus reverts when Owner sends value, so there exist inputs (Owner sending >0 value) where mutant behavior differs.
change_summary: Insert a require that msg.value must be zero before making the call, preventing forwarding of any Ether and reverting when value sent, changing observable behavior when sender provides value.
